crossRefs.note: Therefore wash yourself, anoint yourself, get dressed, and go down to the threshing floor; but don’t make yourself…
Joab sent to Tekoa, and brought a wise woman from there, and said to her, “Please act like a mourner, and put on…
Let your garments be always white, and don’t let your head lack oil.
In those days I, Daniel, was mourning three whole weeks.
I ate no pleasant bread. No meat or wine came into my mouth. I didn’t anoint myself at all, until three whole weeks…
